additional_concerns: The transition preserves processing of specified applications under the existing process. Treating that as a categorical exclusion from item (ii) relief is plausible but not established without the existing process and relevant FAQs. It does not independently establish an approval duty.

The formula fixes pending status at 28 November 2025 and uses assessment_date for commencement. The source does not expressly identify the legally relevant assessment event or resolve withdrawal, replacement or subsequent disposition of a legacy application.

The two supplied external dependency IDs have no source hashes or descriptions identifying their contents. Neither can be treated as available or confidently matched to the FAQs, forms or existing process.

The formula accepts legal classifications as supplied facts; it does not determine home-jurisdiction compliance or the meaning of novel, complex or possible local policy implications. A Boolean result remains conditional on those classifications.
The narrow relief question appropriately avoids inferring that failure establishes an approval duty or that success satisfies notification, filing or post-vetting requirements.
